newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 60 bln bolivar TEM auction Wed.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 60 bln bolivar TEM auction Wed.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Wednesday morning a 40 billion bolivar ($85 million) auction of 180-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills with an 18.45 percent coupon.
The bank said it would also offer 10 billion bolivars ($21 million) in 270-day bills with a 18.87 percent coupon, and another 10 billion bolivars of 359-day bills with a 19.30 percent coupon.
Twenty-four billion bolivars of TEMs are due to mature on Thursday.
The weekly TEM bill auctions are the Central Bank's principal tool of monetary policy, used to restrict liquidity and establish a benchmark for wider interest rates.
